summary: National Bankshares Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the sale of its membership interest in Bearing Insurance Group, LLC to an unaffiliated third party, effective May 1, 2026. The transaction is expected to yield a pre-tax gain of approximately $6.57 million, reported in Q2 2026. Terms such as price, premium, and advisor are not disclosed. The sale was executed through the subsidiary National Bankshares Financial Services, Inc. This is a straightforward divestiture of a non-core insurance brokerage asset. Watch for the Q2 2026 earnings report to confirm the gain and potential redeployment of proceeds into core banking operations.
